description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains for testing stream reliability, including classes for grain state management, grain behavior for producers and consumers, and unsubscribe functionality. It uses conditional compilation for generic and non-generic stream handling, and includes methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, sending items, and retrieving status information.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class holding the state for stream reliability tests, including stream provider name, stream object, producer flag, and consumer subscription handles, with support for generics.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTestGrain
classes.description: Orleans grain implementing stream reliability testing functionalities, supporting both generic and non-generic streams, managing subscriptions, sending items, and reporting status.

classes.name: StreamUnsubscribeTestGrain
classes.description: Orleans grain providing functionality to subscribe and unsubscribe from streams, primarily for testing stream unsubscription behavior.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes stream and subscriptions based on stored state.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, logs deactivation event.

methods.name: GetConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of current consumer subscription handles.

methods.name: GetReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items received by all observers.

methods.name: GetErrorsCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of errors encountered by all observers.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Logs a ping message, used for health checks.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes a new consumer to a stream with specified stream ID and provider.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a specific consumer subscription handle from the stream.

methods.name: RemoveAllConsumers
methods.description: Unsubscribes all consumers from the stream.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Sets the grain as a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: RemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes the grain's producer role for a specific stream.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears all state and subscriptions, resetting the grain.

methods.name: IsConsumer
methods.description: Returns whether the grain is currently a consumer.

methods.name: IsProducer
methods.description: Returns whether the grain is currently a producer.

methods.name: GetConsumerHandlesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of consumer subscription handles.

methods.name: GetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Returns the count of consumer observers.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends an item to the stream via the producer.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Returns the silo address where the grain is located.

methods.name: TryInitStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream object if not already initialized, based on stream ID and provider name.

methods.name: ReconnectConsumerHandles
methods.description: Reconnects existing consumer subscription handles after activation.
